title: My case
intro.title: Your case, explained with official data
intro.body: You have not saved a case on this device yet. You can set it up in a few minutes or look at an example first. Your data stays on your phone.
example.banner: You are viewing an example case: CHNV parole, I-485 filed {receipt}, work permit in {ead}. It is not saved on your device.
switcher.label: Case you are viewing
nickname.label: Label for this case (this device only)
nickname.help: Pick a label. We never store names.
delete.title: Delete this case?
delete.body: This removes the dates and details of this case, and its reminders, from this device. It cannot be undone.
nav.title: More about your case
nav.peers: Why did others get it and not me?
noCase.body: Set up your case or see an example to view this information.
form.privacy: Everything you enter here stays on this device. We never ask for your name or your full receipt number.
form.fixErrors: Check the highlighted answers before you continue.
form.saveError: We could not save the case. Check the dates and try again.
form.maxCases: You can save up to {n} cases on this device.
channel.label: How did you enter the United States?
channel.hint: If your I-94 says "DT", it is CBP One.
dates.paroleDate: Your parole date on the I-94 (optional)
dates.paroleEnd: Original end date of your I-94 (optional)
dates.paroleEnd.help: The date your I-94 had when you entered, not a date written later.
dates.receipt.help: It is on the receipt notice (I-797C). If you only know the month, tick "I only know the month".
error.receiptRequired: Enter the I-485 receipt date, or at least the month.
error.future: The date cannot be in the future.
error.beforeReceipt: This date cannot be earlier than the I-485 receipt ({date}).
error.decisionBeforeInterview: The decision cannot be earlier than the interview ({date}).
error.channelRequired: Pick an option, even if it is "I don't know".
warn.oneYear: Your I-485 seems to have been filed before one year and one day after your parole ({date}). The law requires one year of presence; if you are unsure, consult an attorney or accredited representative.
warn.reTermination: {date} is the date DHS wrote in the April 2026 re-terminations, not your original I-94 end date. If you have the original date, enter it.
where.stateUnknown: I don't know / prefer not to say
where.office.help: If you do not know the office, we use the mix of offices in your state.
where.miamiDade: Do you live in Miami-Dade County?
where.miamiDade.help: In Miami-Dade, USCIS uses the Hialeah, Kendall and Miami offices.
where.receiptPrefix: First 3 letters of your receipt number (optional)
where.receiptPrefix.help: For example IOE. We never store the receipt digits.
received.intro: Mark what has already happened. If you do not remember the exact date, you can leave it blank or use "I only know the month".
received.concurrentI765: Did you file the work permit (I-765) together with the I-485?
milestone.noid: Notice of Intent to Deny (NOID) received
milestone.erequest: Case outside normal processing time inquiry (e-Request)
milestone.congressional_inquiry: Inquiry through your member of Congress
milestone.source: Where does the date come from?
milestone.cardExpiry: Expiry date printed on the card
hardship.title: Documented situations (for a possible expedite)
docs.intro: Say whether you already submitted each document. It is used only for the approval card, never for the timing.
docs.note: This list does not cover everything USCIS reviews (background, prior orders, discretion).
ineligible.title: Your entry
ineligible.noNumbers: For this entry we show no probabilities and no time frames.
ineligible.i220a.body: Under the Board of Immigration Appeals decision (Matter of Cabrera-Fernández, 2023), a release on an I-220A is not treated as parole, so we cannot compute a Cuban Adjustment Act estimate. This could change: there is a pending case in Miami (Bello-Rubio, which has moved forward since {belloDate}, when the court refused to dismiss it) and a pending Board decision after the Labrada-Hechavarria case. No court has yet said that an I-220A is parole.
ineligible.ewi.body: The Cuban Adjustment Act requires having been inspected and admitted, or paroled. An entry without inspection does not meet that requirement by itself, so we do not compute an estimate. Other paths may exist depending on your history.
ineligible.conditional_parole_236.body: Conditional parole (INA 236) is granted inside removal proceedings and, under current practice, is not treated as the parole the Cuban Adjustment Act requires. So we do not compute an estimate.
ineligible.decided.body: Your case already has a decision; we do not compute estimates for decided cases.
ineligible.consult: Consult an attorney or accredited representative about your situation.
ineligible.scam.title: Watch out for scams
share.title: Share a case code
share.intro: A month-level code to share in groups without personal data: no receipt digits, no exact dates and no office unless you add it.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Press and hold the text to copy it.
share.shareFailed: Could not open the share menu. Copy the text instead.
share.reveal.title: Discreet mode
share.reveal.body: Discreet mode is on. Show this case's code on screen?
share.textLabel: Case code (you can select and copy it)
compare.title: Paste a code to compare
compare.help: Paste the code someone else shared. We compare it right here; it is not sent anywhere.
compare.invalid: We do not recognize that code. It must start with #AjusteCubano and include the filing month.
compare.theirs: Possible reasons for the other case
compare.note: The comparison uses only what the code says (months, not days); it is a rough guide.
